comment: Canonical list of MailerLite CUSTOM fields this form writes to. `name` and `phone` are MailerLite built-ins and are not listed here. MailerLite only supports the types text, number and date — every Yes/No answer is stored as the text 'Yes' or 'No', and committees are stored as a comma-separated text list. Run `npm run setup:mailerlite` to create any of these that don't exist yet.
